# ChunkDestroying

> **Kind:** tag · **Registry:** host · **Folder:** [`src/logic/terrain/`](../folders/src-logic-terrain.md)
> **Source:** [`src/logic/terrain/chunk.h`](../../../src/logic/terrain/chunk.h)

## Summary

Chunk is beyond the unload distance and will be destroyed once no worker uses it.

## Description

Emplaced (emplace_or_replace) by ChunkManagerSys when the chunk's centre is farther than view_distance + chunk::length from every load centre; the chunk is removed from ChunkMap at the same time. TerrainSys destroys the entity (and recycles its GPU slot) once it is not ChunkGenerating. ChunkGeneratorSys never starts a job for it.

## Fields

None (tag, opaque type or no data members).
